(1) ZeroSkip can skip zero-weight multiplications in Winograd convolution, thereby reducing the total number of multiplications, and (2) AddOpt can improve the data reuse of addition operations, thereby reducing the number of memory accesses.
ZeroSkip and AddOp improve Winograd convolution performance by 51.8 and 35.6 percent, respectively.
ZeroSkip and Add-Opt achieve 51.7% higher performance for Winograd convolution on a GPU, and even without any hardware change, Add-Opt gives 35.7% performance improvement for Winograd convolution.
